Residential solar program, In order to assist our residents with greater access to sustainable technologies and to help reduce their energy bill, last year the county secured $5 million to provide residential solar to low-income households as a part of the White Oak Technology Park rezoning in the Verona District.

A program known as Solar Access Henrico launched last month to bring this commitment to fruition. Solar Access Henrico is charged with installing new solar panels on homes of residents who may not generally be able to afford them countywide.

Henrico is working with Dominion Energy Solutions to get residents enrolled in the program and signed up to receive their free solar panels. We expect about 200 to 250 homes to get solar panels through Solar Access Henrico.

The process is easy. Complete a form on the Dominion Energy Solution website, and you will be contacted to go over eligibility and get you enrolled in the program. For example, the solar production of the program reduces greenhouse emissions from 3 to 6 tons per year, or 3,500 to 6,600 pounds of coal burn.
